verdict.rationale: Homebrew's manpage documents a command to control its anonymous aggregate user behaviour analytics, and `brew analytics off` turns them off. That directly delivers the opt-out this story asks for. Missing for 10: documentation of what data is collected and how the opt-out persists or is applied non-interactively (e.g. an environment variable for CI/agent runs), plus independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
